question: What condition must hold for the act of applying meditation to follow worship of the circle in this sequence?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the application of meditation.
The duration of meditation is set by a temporal limit.
The practitioner actively applies meditation after completing worship.
inference: Meditation is applied only for as long as the prescribed temporal condition holds after worshipping the circle.
uncertainties: Extent of the temporal limit remains unspecified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the prescribed time lasts.
